description_en: Queries penalties for domain names added to Web Application Firewall (WAF) without an Internet Content Provider (ICP) filing
description_zh: 查询已接入WAF域名的未备案处罚信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-punished-domains --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-uqm0000qa07 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePunishedDomains

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of domain names added to WAF
parameters.name: domains

parameters.help_en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The penalty type. Valid values:

beian (default): ICP filing center.

punishCenter: penalty center
parameters.help_zh:
处罚类型，取值：
beian(默认)：表示备案中心。

punishCenter：表示处罚中心
parameters.name: punish_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

PunishedDomains.description_en: The list of domain names penalized for not having an ICP filing
PunishedDomains.description_zh: 未备案处罚的域名列表

items.description_en: A domain name penalized for not having an ICP filing
